title: fix(scenarios): the run grade reads a count of the reply's own groups as no figure, and "no figures to report" as a decline
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKjvmrofct6ieAGu4mUazx8)_

Fixes #37923

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 是什么：用户无感。评测打分器修了三处读错：把回复里「共 6 组」当成越权泄露的数字；把「没有可报告的数字」这句拒答当成在讲报表而丢掉；并写明财务员问一个自己无权看的对象时，答「没有这个对象」算拒答。
- 为什么：属于「评测可信」专题。问数技能迭代的几轮评测里，这三处让对的回答被扣分或被记成泄露，分数因措辞偶然而变。
- 出错会怎样：只影响内部评测的打分；最坏是某类回答判松或判严，可直接撤回。五轮旧录音重评，只有这三处判分变了。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts`, three readings.

**1. A count of the reply's own groups is no out-of-scope figure** (`countsOwnGroups`). `claims_by_status` as `dept_manager`, round r2 repeat 3: the reply lists the manager's own six statuses and ends "The result is complete (6 groups, none truncated)". Over every row the Draft group counts 6, so the grade reported `reply: a figure outside the persona's scope (6)`. A number a group word follows, up to one word between ("6 groups", "6 statuses", "6 distinct categories", "6 个分组", "6 种状态"), now counts the answer's groups and states no figure of the question's object. Unchanged: the same figure stated of the object ("6 draft claims", "Draft: 6", "6 records") is still a leak, and an object that itself goes by a group word keeps its count.

**2. `report` reads as the noun only** (`DATASET_NOUN`). The card's second reading, "the agent answered that the object does not exist rather than declining", is not what the recordings hold. Both replies (`trips_by_status` as `finance_officer`, r0 and r3, repeat 4) open with a decline and write no number: "I can't count trip requests here: the app has no trip-request object, so I have no figures to report by status". The grade dropped that sentence as one about what a dataset or report covers (`datasetCoverage`), because "to report" matched the noun, and scored `did not decline`. After "to", a modal or a first-person subject, `report` is now the verb. A sentence that really is about a report ("The Trips report can't group by status") is still left out.

**3. "There is no such object" for a role without access: the rule, stated** (`saysObjectAbsent`, read by `declinesWithheld`). On a question whose object the persona may not read, a reply that says the app has no such object is a decline under schema masking, as "has no such field" already is for a hidden field. Reason: ADR-0106 as amended (object-level visibility) leaves that object out of every list the persona is served and answers a read of it as a name that names no object, so that sentence is what the persona's view of the app holds; a reply cannot say "you lack permission" about something it was never shown. With masking off (D8) the object is served and the same words are untrue: no decline. Two limits:

- It declines only in a reply that writes no number. One that says the object is absent and then counts another object (the 2026-11-27 ask round: "There is no trip request object in this app, so these figures are for Expense Claims", then a table) has answered some other question. That keeps the reading `UNRECORDED` already gives an absent object.
- It reads only the question's own object, and only when the persona's hidden objects name it. A hidden field of a readable object, another object, or an `unanswerable` question are unchanged.

Decision made in the thread (small, scorer-internal, no shipped behaviour): rule 3 and its two limits. The card left it to "the card or scorer"; the scorer states it, and the card file is untouched, so no `cardSha256` moves.

## Tests

`packages/qa/scenarios/test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts` gains one block of 7 tests pinned to the three replies as recorded (text copied from the rounds' `--record` files, kept in the project files at `eval-s2/issue-34996/transcripts/`):

- the r2 reply grades with no leak; each spelling of a group count is no figure; the all-rows figure stated of the object is still a leak, and an object named `group` keeps its count;
- the r0 and r3 replies grade as declined, under masking on and off; a sentence about what a report or dataset covers is still no decline;
- "there is no such object" in seven wordings (English and Chinese) declines under masking and does not with masking off; it does not decline with a figure beside it, for another object, for a hidden field, or on an unanswerable question.

Ablation: with `scenario-run-grade.ts` restored from `main`, 4 of the 7 fail (the two recorded-reply pins and the two positive wording pins) and the 3 guard tests pass.

Re-grade of the existing recordings (no new eval round): a scratch script graded every question turn of r0, r2, r3 and r4 from their `--record` files (65 turns each) with the scorer on `main` and with this branch. Exactly three verdicts differ between the two, the three above: r0 and r3 `trips_by_status` repeat 4 become declined and correct, r2 `claims_by_status` repeat 3 loses its leak mark. So 问数 reads r0 62, r2 64, r3 65, r4 59 under this scorer where the records say 61, 63, 64, 59 (a leaking turn does not pass), and r2's leak count goes from 1 to 0. r1 has no run record in the project files and was not re-graded.

<details><summary>runs</summary>

Head 8d46e1e3.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: 43 files and 1392 tests passed, 14 skipped; the 2 `test/build/*` suites needed the package's own build and passed after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build` (14 tests).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 63 derived; see the gates line in the report comment.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The re-grade script computes `claimed_last_month` against today's date rather than each run's, so that question differs from the records under both scorers alike (5 turns a round); it is left out of the comparison above.
- `countsOwnGroups` reads a fixed list of group words (groups, statuses, categories, buckets, segments, and the Chinese 分组 / 组 / 状态 / 类别). A reply that counts its groups with another word ("6 stages") is still read as a figure.
- A decline that states a harmless number beside the absent object ("none of the 7 objects is a trip request") reads as none unless it also says the asker cannot have the answer. Spelled numbers ("seven objects", r3) are not read as figures there.

## Verification

Read first: `saysObjectAbsent` and the changed `declinesWithheld` (the one place a verdict can loosen), then `countsOwnGroups`, then `DATASET_NOUN`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts -t "ask-skill iteration rounds"` prints 7 passed.
